description: This file is a React component implementation for an 'Errors' tab in a trace viewer application. It manages displaying error messages, error details, source code frames associated with errors, and copying prompts related to errors. It utilizes React hooks, fetches source code snippets, and renders error information with interaction options.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: React functional component providing a button to copy an error prompt to clipboard.

classes.name: ErrorsTab
classes.description: Main React component representing the errors tab in the trace viewer, rendering error list, error details, and source code frames.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom React hook that processes a TraceModel to extract and memoize error descriptions.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: Component that displays individual error messages with location and action links.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Utility function that generates a source code snippet with an error marker for display.
